observations: Native query tests cover strict/stale guards, nearest/no hit, clipping/backface rules, actual triangle empty-corner rejection, rotated boxes, framed bounds, frozen runtime hierarchy and posed skin geometry.
Both GPU runs send look, fly, pan, wheel, frame, selection and cancellation messages to the owned native Scene HWND, preserving shared service and Inspector guards.
Both GUI runs save and restore a floating Inspector within the session and restore it again in a fresh process.
Layout contract passes 24 cases on Linux and native Windows, including malformed/unsupported input preservation and atomic replacement while an old reader retains previous bytes.
Contracts caught and resolved missing InvalidDataException handling and Windows File.Move replacement refusal with a delete-sharing reader; existing-file publication now uses File.Replace.
limitations: Owned-HWND message tests are not physical mouse/keyboard/IME or accessibility qualification.
Alt orbit math and ordinary control routing are implemented; this harness does not synthesize physical Alt state or qualify unlimited cursor motion.
Only the laptop display arrangement is covered; arbitrary multi-monitor/DPI transitions remain unqualified.
Picking is a linear CPU triangle query after per-object bounds rejection, not pixel-exact rasterization or production-scale accelerated picking.
Transform gizmos, multiselect, automatic real-time Play and broader engine milestones remain unfinished.
Resource samples and small fixture rendering do not qualify shipped-game performance.
